title: Data Analyst - 8 Month FTC
description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Data is a key asset to Allica and is deeply embedded in all our teams and products. With data, we assist and work with Finance, Operations, Credit Risk, Product and management.

We are looking for ambitious and curious people who can help us understand our data better, contribute to facilitating the discussions between engineering and the data stakeholders and have an impact on the business by telling stories around the insights they generate.

You will be an integral part of the newly formed business intelligence team, building and developing the analytics and insights capabilities of the Bank.

Role Description

Data is a key asset to Allica and is deeply embedded in all our teams and products. With data, we assist and work with Finance, Operations, Credit Risk, Product and management.

We are looking for ambitious and curious people who can help us understand our data better, contribute to facilitating the discussions between engineering and the data stakeholders and have an impact on the business by telling stories around the insights they generate.

You will be an integral part of the newly formed business intelligence team, building and developing the analytics and insights capabilities of the Bank.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Understand our products and processes through the data we have or collect

  • Help the various stakeholders leverage your knowledge of that data to build reporting that will improve their KPI’s

  • Originate, maintain and enhance data analytics ETL’s.

  • Build dashboards and reports (Looker)

  • Work with product teams and other stakeholders (Ops, finance, risk, etc) to understand their data needs and deliver their data requests.

  • Develop and maintain data standards, always managing the data libraries and dictionaries, documenting your findings and sharing them both within and outside the data team.

  • Helping us implement a data-driven mindset in the company.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Previous experience working as a data analyst in a start-up or fast-paced organisation.

  • You have a proven track record with SQL and writing querie (GCP/BigQuery Preferred).

  • You have a solid foundation in Python programming or a strong desire to learn with basic knowledge already achieved.

  • You are flexible to adapt quickly to changing priorities within a very dynamic environment and work well with stakeholders across the business.

  • You communicate effectively and are comfortable with translating technical detail into business and commercial language.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Stage - Data Scientist / Data Analyst (H/F)
description:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous !

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) futur(e) Data Scientist / Data Analyst (H/F) pour rejoindre nos équipes à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois de fin d’études de M2 à partir de mars 2027. Ce stage est basé à Paris (75). 

Intégré(e) au sein du pôle E-commerce et rattaché(e) au Lead Data Science & Analytics, vous accompagnerez l’équipe dans les sujets du quotidien ainsi que dans la construction de projets dédiés. Vous serez amené(e)s à travailler sur les sujets suivants :

Data Analyse

Vous serez un(e) membre à part entière de l'équipe Data Science & Analytics et participerez activement à son quotidien :

  • Analyses Ad Hoc : Vous mènerez diverses analyses ponctuelles indispensables pour affiner notre compréhension de nos marques, de la performance de nos produits et du comportement de nos client(e)s.
  • Excellence Opérationnelle : Vous contribuerez au développement continu de l'équipe en identifiant les points de friction, en structurant de nouveaux process et en automatisant les tâches récurrentes.
  • Reporting & Communication Métiers: Vous prendrez la responsabilité de plusieurs mises à jour de reportings. Vous serez responsable du maintien de dashboards hebdomadaires, de reportings mensuels, et de l'initiation des communications clés à destination des équipes métiers.
  • Accompagnement Marketing : Vous participerez aux opérations courantes en réalisant des extractions de données ciblées pour nos initiatives marketing. Cela inclut la mise en place de groupes de contrôle rigoureux et la mesure de la performance incrémentale de ces campagnes.
  • Intégration de l'IA : Vous serez amené(e) à utiliser l'IA au quotidien dans vos missions et participerez activement à la définition et au partage des bonnes pratiques quant à son utilisation au sein de l'équipe.


Mise en place d’un moteur d'Embeddings Produits (NLP) : Vous serez au cœur du développement d’un socle algorithmique clé : la transformation de descriptions textuelles en représentations vectorielles (embeddings). Ce projet nourrira de multiples initiatives futures.

Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie du projet :

  • Data Preprocessing : Nettoyage des données textuelles issues du catalogue, normalisation, et préparation des corpus d'entraînement.
  • Modélisation : Benchmark, sélection fine-tuning des modèles appropriés (Sentence-Transformers, LLMs, etc.).
  • Industrialisation : Le stage ne s’arrête pas au prototype expérimental. Vous participerez activement au déploiement du pipeline dans notre environnement de production via Metaflow.
  • Monitoring : Mise en place de l'automatisation pour la mise à jour des vecteurs lors des nouvelles collections et monitoring de la qualité des embeddings dans le temps.

Requirements

  • Vous êtes étudiant(e) en dernière année de formation supérieure (BAC+5) avec une spécialité en Data Science / Machine Learning.
  • Une maîtrise suffisante de SQL est essentielle.
  • Des connaissances en Python seront valorisées.
  • Compréhension des algorithmes de Machine Learning et un fort intérêt pour le NLP.
  • Sensible aux problématiques business : vous êtes animé(e) par l’envie de comprendre nos clients, nos produits et nos process pour générer de l'impact.
  • Compétences en visualisation de données pour restituer vos analyses de manière claire.
  • Vous êtes rigoureux(se), structuré(e) et avez un fort esprit d'équipe.
  • Force de proposition : vous aimez évoluer dans un environnement où il reste des choses à construire.


Ce que ce stage vous apportera :

  • Une montée en compétences technique pointue en Python et SQL.
  • L’opportunité de travailler sur une stack data moderne et robuste (AWS, Redshift, Metaflow, Git, etc.).
  • Le passage de la théorie à la pratique : vous verrez votre code et vos modèles partir en production.
  • L’affinage de votre sens métier et de votre esprit critique au contact d'équipes variées (Tech, E-commerce, CRM, Marketing).

Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles.

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Controller*in Senior / Business Analyst*in (m/w/d) in Bonn
description:
WIR suchen dich!

  • Du gestaltest das Controlling der Zukunft durch den Einsatz moderner Analyse-, Business-Intelligence-, Predictive-Analytics- und KI-Lösungen. Dabei agierst du als Sparringspartner*in für unsere Fachbereiche, entwickelst Self-Service-Lösungen, förderst Datenkompetenz und treibst die Nutzung moderner BI- und KI-Technologien voran.


Tu, was du liebst

  • Du agierst als Sparringspartner*in der Fachbereiche und berätst sie zu Budgets, laufenden Ausgaben und Forecasts. Dabei identifizierst du (finanz-)kritische Entwicklungen und Herausforderungen, entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen geeignete Gegenmaßnahmen und begleitest deren Umsetzung.
  • Du bewertest gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen die Entwicklung relevanter Kennzahlen, führst bei Bedarf vertiefende Analysen durch und berätst bei der Ableitung geeigneter Handlungsmaßnahmen.
  • Du unterstützt die Fachbereiche aktiv bei der Erstellung von Kosten-Nutzen-Analysen und Business Cases und bewertest geplante Maßnahmen aus betriebswirtschaftlicher Sicht. Dabei hinterfragst du Ziele und Annahmen kritisch und stehst den Fachbereichen als Sparringspartner*in beratend zur Seite.
  • Du führst Ad-hoc-Analysen durch, um aktuelle Geschäftsentwicklungen zu bewerten und Auffälligkeiten zu analysieren. Die gewonnenen Erkenntnisse bereitest du adressatengerecht auf und unterstützt die Fachbereiche bei der Ableitung geeigneter Maßnahmen.
  • Du entwickelst bei Bedarf neue Berichte und Dashboards, um relevante Entwicklungen dauerhaft transparent zu machen. Zudem überprüfst du regelmäßig Kennzahlen, Berichte und Dashboards, entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter und dokumentierst ihre Anwendung. Dabei treibst du die Automatisierung von Reports und Dashboards aktiv voran.
  • Du entwickelst Analyse-Tools, um ein nutzerfreundliches und effizientes Arbeiten mit Daten zu ermöglichen, beispielsweise durch Self-Service-Lösungen für Fachbereiche, Dashboards oder Datenmodelle im MDP-Business-Layer. Dabei setzt du KI-Technologien gezielt ein. Du dokumentierst Aufbau, Nutzung und Funktionsweise der Tools, pflegst sie und entwickelst sie bedarfsgerecht weiter.
  • Du begleitest die Erstellung des Jahresbudgets sowie die damit verbundenen Abstimmungs- und Genehmigungsprozesse.
  • Du fungierst als zentrale Ansprechperson für die Kolleg*innen der Finanzbuchhaltung.
  • Du beobachtest aktuelle Entwicklungen und Trends in den Bereichen Datenanalyse, Business Intelligence, Predictive Analytics und KI und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung des Controllings mit.


Zeig, was du kannst

  • Abgeschlossenes (Fach-)Hochschulstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Controlling, Business Analytics, Business Intelligence oder Datenanalyse.
  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung komplexer Analyse-, Reporting- und Steuerungslösungen.
  • Ausgeprägte analytische, konzeptionelle und betriebswirtschaftliche Fähigkeiten sowie eine hohe Methoden- und Problemlösungskompetenz.
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Fachbereiche zu beraten.
  • Sicheres Auftreten, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder zu überzeugen.
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kennzahlen, Dashboards, Business Cases sowie modernen Analyse- und BI-Werkzeugen.
  • Proaktive Auseinandersetzung mit aktuellen Entwicklungen und Trends im Bereich Datenanalyse, Business Intelligence und KI.


Unser Erfolgsrezept: Das WIR gewinnt

  • Ein Job, in dem man mit viel Spaß, Gestaltungsmöglichkeit und freier Zeiteinteilung Gutes tun kann.
  • Persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung durch individuelle Fortbildungen, Coaching, Leadership-Programme, Masterplan und Entwicklungspläne sind selbstverständlich.
  • Gleitzeit und mobiles Arbeiten unterstützen dich dabei, Beruf und Privatleben zu vereinbaren.
  • Wertschätzende Atmosphäre, klare Führung und die Möglichkeit, aus Fehlern zu lernen, sind Teil unserer Kultur, sowie ein nachhaltiges Arbeitsumfeld.
  • Wir bieten individuelle Hilfsmittel, Leitsysteme und technische Hilfen, um barrierefreies Arbeiten zu ermöglichen. Wenn du eine Assistenz oder einen Assistenzhund hast – auch die sind bei uns herzlich willkommen.

Altersversorgung sowie Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft, kostenloser PKW- und Fahrradparkplatz in unserer Tiefgarage, kostenloser Fahrradverleih, Fahrgemeinschaften.

title: Lead Business Analyst, Process & Automation (Berlin | remote)
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

 

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Lead Business Analyst, Process & Automation to join our Capital and Payments team. Process & Automation is a small team working across the operations behind payments, lending, underwriting, risk, and billing. We find operational friction, diagnose root causes, and build the process, data, tooling, and automation solutions that fix it.

You will own projects end to end: find where a process is failing or create toil, prove it with data, design something better, coordinate the build with stakeholders, and stay with it until the receiving team owns it and the numbers have moved. AI is a default tool in how we work rather than a separate initiative.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with full ownership of your projects.

 
 

What you’ll be doing:

  • Define: map end-to-end flows, trace handoffs, and understand how a process actually runs rather than how it is documented.

  • Diagnose: separate root causes from symptoms and quantify where time, money, and customers are being lost.

  • Design: turn what you find into clear requirements, better flows, and delivery plans with measurable success criteria, then build or coordinate the automation, tooling, data, and controls they depend on.

  • Instrument: lead testing and launch readiness, track impact against agreed measures, drive adoption, and hand ownership back to the team that owns the outcome.

  • Establish how we use AI agents in operations: identify where they create real leverage, then design, test, and deploy them for bounded, multi-step workflows, including the evaluation methods that prove they work.

  • Partner with teams outside operations whose work affects these outcomes, and turn operational findings into business cases that help Product and Technology prioritize longer-term solutions.

 
 

What you need to bring:

We're looking for a candidate who has experience with the following:

  • 7+ years in business analysis, process improvement, operations, implementation, or product operations.

  • A track record leading complex cross-functional projects from problem definition through implementation and ongoing measurement.

  • Strong analytical skills - you use data, queries, and dashboards to validate problems and prove outcomes, not only to report on them.

  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, process designs, and delivery plans.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, written communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of driving alignment and outcomes across teams you do not manage.

 
 

Even better if you have, but not necessary:

  • Financial services, fintech, payments, lending, or insurance - or another complex, regulated operating environment.

  • Commerce, e-commerce, point-of-sale, or marketplace experience.

  • Hands-on experience with workflow, case-management, or process-automation platforms.

  • SQL, business-intelligence tools, or data modelling.

  • Experience evaluating or deploying AI-enabled solutions for operational use cases.

  • Experience driving adoption and effectiveness after launch, not just delivery.

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

Be a changemaker

 
 

You’ll enjoy:

  • A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

  • A culture that celebrates performance

  • The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

  • Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

  • Equity options, because this is your company too

  • Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters

  • Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

  • Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

  • Etc…

 

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.
